fees.name: Single-entry e-visa
fees.notes: Amount consistently reported by third-party visa-guide sources (evisaguides.com, tajikistan-evisa.com, traveldoc.aero). Could not independently confirm the fee schedule text on evisa.tj because the official site loads its content via client-side JavaScript that could not be rendered by automated fetch. Treat as high-likelihood but unverified-official; re-check directly on evisa.tj before relying on it.

fees.name: Multiple-entry e-visa
fees.notes: Reported by third-party sources; same rendering limitation as single-entry e-visa above. Not independently confirmed on the official portal text.

fees.name: GBAO (Gorno-Badakhshan Autonomous Region) permit add-on
fees.notes: Add-on permit fee on top of the e-visa fee, reported by third-party sources ($20-30 range cited); could not confirm exact current amount on the official portal directly.

fees.name: Standard consular visa (embassy-issued), USA nationals
fees.validity: up to 1 year (visa types K, KhS1, O1, O2)
fees.notes: Official published consular fee schedule at the Embassy of Tajikistan to the USA, dated 25.11.2019 (still live on the embassy site as of 2026-07-02, not confirmed re-dated). Fee is set per bilateral reciprocity with the USA and is notably higher than for most other nationalities. Visa type 'M'/'TB' (business/work-related) is 190 USD; minor-citizen visas of any type are 160 USD.

fees.name: Standard consular visa (embassy-issued), USA nationals - business/work type (M, TB)
fees.notes: Official embassy-published fee for visa types 'M' and 'TB' issued to US citizens.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (airport)
fees.applies: eligible nationalities where VOA is permitted
fees.notes: Reported by a visa-service intermediary, not confirmed on a government source. Tajikistan's visa-on-arrival availability is limited and nationality-dependent; verify eligibility and current fee directly with the airport immigration authority or MFA before travel.

reciprocity_variations.note: Official embassy-published reciprocity fee for US citizens (visa types K/KhS1/O1/O2, up to 1 year) is markedly higher than the general e-visa fee; business/work types (M/TB) are 190 USD. Source: mfa.tj Washington consular fees page.
